brief: Holds one rule about an entity-relationship schema, a stzGraphRule that belongs to the er domain.
detail: The four built-in schema rules are stzErRule objects made by stzErRuleSet: entity_has_key, foreign_key_resolves, relation_backed_by_key and participation_matches_nullability. Build one yourself with a name, set its severity, message and checker like any stzGraphRule, and add it to a stzErRuleSet.
